rationale: Re-verified 2026-10-08: the vulnerable JaegerPropagator.extract is only reachable once the propagator is registered, and the telemetry wiring this transitive copy serves (OpenTelemetrySDK.ts, the source of the published domain-events-infra the bundled home server depends on) passes a single explicit textMapPropagator of AWSXRayPropagator, which replaces the default propagator set; no OTEL_PROPAGATORS value exists anywhere in the repository to re-add jaeger. The patched 2.9.0 line requires migrating the whole pinned OpenTelemetry 1.19.x family, inside a published patched dependency of the app lock domain, so it cannot be a resolution here.

Re-verified 2026-10-08 structurally rather than by intent: the advisory is a crash in the Prometheus exporter's HTTP listener, and @opentelemetry/exporter-prometheus appears zero times in app/yarn.lock because sdk-node 0.46.0 does not depend on it, so the vulnerable module is absent from the installed graph and the listener cannot be constructed; the telemetry wiring supplies an explicit OTLP PeriodicExportingMetricReader instead. The patched 0.217.0 line needs @opentelemetry/api >= 1.9 while 0.46.0 pins the peer to < 1.8, so it is a family migration in the app lock domain, not a resolution.
